cacheAdvice.policy: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED after checksum reads of files >= 8 MiB
cacheAdvice.scope: Per-file advisory request after completed reads; no file edits or global cache drop. The kernel may retain pages; measured cgroup composition establishes the observed effect.

candidate.scope: Measured segment counts, not built states. Road interval excludes all restriction member ways at lower end and none at upper end. History ceiling sums all candidate proper prefixes; mode/relevance/failed candidates may overcount. Node barriers affect transitions, not road records.

nodeStorage.scope: Pages are keyed by original ID; no remapping or dense highest-ID allocation. Sparse IDs can waste a page each. Container bytes exclude allocator/runtime/source caches; measured cgroup peak governs admission.

selection.scope: Sparse bitmap pages and sets contain original IDs; no location cache, dense highest-ID array or remapping. Parent relation closure is recursive; references are completed separately from the original PBF.

frontier.scope: Remaining-time spherical envelopes for every recorded reachable cut, using the static model's maximum supported speed and nonnegative costs. Retains existing margins, rounds outward to 0.1 degree, then clips to cached parent. Conditional on unchanged interior prefixes/topology; not a coverage certificate. Source gaps and newly restored restrictions/roads require fresh qualification.

profile.purpose: Census the cached portion of all 120-minute continuation envelopes. Eastern/southern envelopes exceed parent coverage; source gaps remain explicit. No new graph or complete coverage claim.

sampling.scope: Periodic samples can miss brief composition peaks. Field maxima are not simultaneous and must not be summed. memory.peak is a separate cumulative kernel counter; host/VM paging is unmeasured.
